Let \(u=\lg\lg 3\). Since \(\log_3 10=\frac1{\lg 3}\),

\[
\lg\log_3 10 = \lg\left(\frac1{\lg 3}\right)=-\lg\lg 3=-u.
\]

The nonconstant part of \(f\) is odd:

\[
a\sin x - b\sqrt[3]{x} + c\ln(x+\sqrt{x^2+1})
\]

so

\[
f(-x)+f(x)=8.
\]

Given \(f(-u)=5\), we get

\[
f(u)=8-5=3.
\]

\[
\boxed{3}
\]
